title: Poland and Romania Scramble Aircraft Again as Russia Strikes Ukraine; No Airspace Violations
detail: Poland's Operational Command launched another preventive military aviation operation on the morning of September 21, activating fighter jets and placing ground-based air-defence systems and radar reconnaissance on alert amid a fresh Russian strike wave on Ukraine; the army confirmed no violation of Polish airspace. Separately, Romania's Ministry of National Defence radar detected an aerial target 12km north of Chilia in Tulcea County; two F-16s from the 86th Air Base at Borcea scrambled at 05:30 to monitor, with the alert concluding at 06:14 and no incursion into Romanian airspace reported.

media.caption: Polish military aviation on preventive alert amid Russian strikes on Ukraine
